entries.alt: People gathered near the temple lift their faces toward the sky.
entries.caption: Faces turn upward as the people listen again. This time they understand the voice directing them to the Beloved Son.
entries.findings: Photographic varied faces, eyes, skin and woven cloth; coherent crowd anatomy and upward attention. No visible Jesus or descending figure, preserving the moment before verse8. Upward gaze is source-required here, not failed reciprocal eye contact. Architecture and unnamed people are interpretation.
conditions: Do not identify unnamed participants, infer family relationships or claim the temple architecture is archaeologically authenticated.
Retain sequence before the descent; no Christ figure yet.
